name: axiom-json-log-native-screen-s0-constants-v1
purpose: Frozen enumeration of every S0 engine constant, context key, table size, hash, probability rule, mixer/SSE parameter, integer rounding rule, escape code, and stream grammar rule for the preregistered json-log-native-screen-s0-v1 development screen.

frozen_order.name: m1-m2
mechanisms: time delta by type with escape

items.process_order: references.items order; all model/cache/dictionary/probability/segment state resets to the fixed empty initial state at every item boundary

context_layout.bittree_node_count_rule: width = bits_needed(alphabet-1); nodes = 2^width - 1; symbol coded most-significant-bit-first down the tree

shared_literal_length_contexts.note: Dedicated ContextStore members (not part of the binary bits[] array or trees[]); used only by literal() runs.

chassis_full_arm_totals.note: Every arm that reaches M4 (full and leave-one-out arms) allocates the identical M1+M2+M3+M4 context space so every absolute context index is arm-invariant; unused blocks never charge events. m1-m2-m3 arm allocates only through the M3 block.

block_allocation_by_arm.note_m1m2m4_and_full: m1-m2-m4 and every full/leave-one-out arm allocate the M3 block even when M3 is not in the mechanism chain, to keep absolute indices arm-invariant.
block_allocation_by_arm.note_m1m2m5: m1-m2-m5 uses the m2 context space only (m2_contexts) plus the M5 estimator, which is separate from the context store.

raw_o3_own_context_space.note: Separate ContextStore, not the chassis layout.
raw_o3_own_context_space.context_selection: order3_tree(history[3]) = fnv1a64_extend(fnv1a64(b"s0-raw-o3"), &history) as usize & (262144 - 1); history is the previous three decoded bytes, initial [0,0,0]

declared_ceilings.note: These are declared/compile-time-asserted ceilings; the engine does not sum resident bytes at runtime and enforce this total. See notes for the per-component compile assertions.

probability_model.update_rule: p1' = clamp(p1 + ((target - p1) >> rate_shift), MIN_PROBABILITY, MAX_PROBABILITY); target = 65536 if bit else 0; charge happens before update
probability_model.observed_probability_rule: P(observed bit) = p1 if bit else 65536 - p1

loss_table.index: probability of the observed bit in [1, 65535]; get(0) is forbidden and rejected
loss_table.value_rule: loss_q24(q) = ((16 - exponent) << 24) - fractional_q24 where exponent = 31 - leading_zeros(q); fractional_q24 built by 24 rounds of repeated squaring of the normalized mantissa in Q63, appending a 1 bit whenever the square reaches 2^64 (then halving)
loss_table.slot_zero_rule: values[0] = values[1] (unused; kept equal to q=1 so the full-table digest is stable)
loss_table.conservative_rounding: truncated logarithm makes each charged loss conservative by less than one Q24 unit
loss_table.sha256_method: Sha256 over the 65536 u32 values in little-endian byte order (values[0]=loss_q24(1), values[q]=loss_q24(q) for q in 1..65536); 262144 bytes total. Digest recomputed independently outside the repo from the exact loss_q24 rule.

mixer_and_sse.gradient_step_rule: delta = (error_q16 * stretch_q24) >> 34; error = (65536 if bit else 0) - mixed_probability
mixer_and_sse.mixer_entry_layout: 4 bytes weight_base (i32) + 4 bytes weight_adaptive (i32) + 2 bytes adaptive probability (u16)

stretch_table.value_rule: stretch(p) = loss(65536 - p) - loss(p) in Q24 log2-odds, derived exactly from the frozen loss table; stretch[0] = stretch[1]; stretch[32768] = 0; antisymmetric about p=32768

predict_rules.stretch_input_clamp: each stretch input clamped to [-STRETCH_CLAMP, STRETCH_CLAMP]
predict_rules.mixed_probability: squash(mixed_q24) via binary search for the smallest probability whose stretch >= target
predict_rules.sse_locate: span = 2*STRETCH_CLAMP; offset = mixed_q24 + STRETCH_CLAMP; scaled = (offset * (SSE_NODES-1) << 16) / span; node = scaled >> 16; fraction = scaled & 0xffff; if node >= SSE_NODES-1 then node = SSE_NODES-2, fraction = 65536
predict_rules.sse_interpolated: (low * (65536 - fraction) + high * fraction) >> 16, low/high = neighboring SSE node probabilities

mixer_and_sse.sse_bucket_bits_rule: sse_bucket_bits = 17 when declared_ceilings.sse_table_bytes_maximum == 16777216 (table 8650752 bytes) and 18 when it == 25165824 (table 17301504 bytes); realized by M5Mixer::with_sse_bucket_bits. The mixer table never changes size (10485760 bytes <= 16777216 always).

m1_order1_order2_mean.rule: mixed_p1 = (p1_order1 + p1_order2) / 2 (integer floor); p0 = 65536 - mixed_p1; both order-1 and order-2 tree cells update after charging
m1_order1_order2_mean.rounding: odd sums round one unit toward zero for p1
m1_order1_order2_mean.usage: top-level JSON value bytes coded via mixed_symbol(order1_tree, order2_tree); order-1 context = previous byte, order-2 context = previous two bytes, both under the value's lane key

m5_final_mix.rule: final = clamp((3 * sse_interpolated + squash(mixer_mix)) / 4, MIN, MAX); integer division
m5_final_mix.note: M5 changes only the charged probability, never a tape bit, grammar, or event count

fnv1a64.byte_order: per byte: hash = (hash XOR byte) * prime, wrapping u64; standard FNV-1a

hash_functions.lane_key: fnv1a64_extend(fnv1a64(skeleton), &(index as u16).to_le_bytes()); index is the top-level value position, u16 little-endian
hash_functions.lane_bucket: lane_key as usize & (LANE_BUCKETS(1024) - 1); used by M2, M3, M4 binary buckets
hash_functions.template_fnv_role: rejection-filter only: TemplateStore/SessionStore/TokenStore hashes only reject non-candidates; every hit and duplicate check compares complete stored bytes for equality, in ascending slot order

event_identity_namespaces.note: Stable per-event identities feeding the optional M5 estimator hash; pinned because changing them changes every M5-arm loss.

record_types.coded_by: TYPE_TREE symbol in the tree indexed by the PREVIOUS record type (type_tree(previous) = TYPE_TREE_BASE + previous); alphabet 4

record_framing.per_record_prefix: MORE_CONTEXT bit = true before each record; a final MORE_CONTEXT bit = false ends the stream
record_framing.terminated_bit: after the final MORE=false, if any record was emitted, one TERMINATED_CONTEXT bit encodes whether the last record ended with LF
record_framing.record_definition: exact byte sequence through and including LF; a final nonempty unterminated suffix is one record; an empty final suffix is not a record

hit_grammar.same_template_bit: if a previous template slot exists, one SAME_TEMPLATE_CONTEXT bit (hit.same_as_last)
hit_grammar.slot_symbol: if no previous slot OR not same_as_last, one SLOT_TREE symbol (alphabet 4096) selecting the template slot
hit_grammar.values: each top-level value coded through the arm's ValueCoder chain under its lane_key; decoder reparses the reconstructed record and rejects any layout mismatch (no structure injection)

miss_grammar.body: entire record coded as one literal() run (valid JSON <= 1048576 bytes fits MAX_LITERAL_RUN); then template insert; then on_slots_cleared(cleared) and after_miss_insert(slot) hooks in that order

fallback_grammar.trigger: malformed JSON, non-object top level, record > 1048576 bytes, depth > 32, or field count > 256
fallback_grammar.chunking: record split into ceil(len / MAX_VALUE_BYTES) chunks of at most MAX_VALUE_BYTES = 1048576 bytes; each chunk = one literal() run followed by a FALLBACK_MORE_CONTEXT bit (more chunks follow?)
fallback_grammar.state: fallback does not update structure-specific state

escape_codes_and_grammar.empty_grammar: just the Empty record-type symbol; no body

literal_run_grammar.length_coding: encode_length: LENGTH_CLASS tree (alphabet 21) codes class-1 = floor(log2(len)); then class-1 mantissa bits from a triangular-offset shared mantissa array; length in [1, MAX_LITERAL_RUN]
literal_run_grammar.bytes: raw literal bytes appended to the tape literal channel; charged exactly 8 bits each (not modeled events)

m2_grammar.lane_eligibility: only top-level value positions 0..63 (M2_LANES_PER_SLOT = 64) may carry typed state; index >= 64 always uses inner M1 coding and carries no M2 state
m2_grammar.canonical_integer_rule: classify_id accepts 0 or -?[1-9][0-9]* that fits i64 and excludes i64::MIN; leading zeros, -0, +, ., and exponents classify as Other
m2_grammar.id_delta: on an armed Id lane: ID_HIT bit; if hit, signed delta of i128(current)-i128(previous) via the ID delta family
m2_grammar.time_byte_grammar: classify_time accepts quoted YYYY-MM-DD[ Tt]HH:MM:SS[.1-9 digits](Z|z|+hh:mm|-hh:mm|+hhmm|-hhmm); shape = {separator, fraction_width, zone_length, zone[6]} reproduced verbatim; scaled = nanoseconds since 0000-01-01 proleptic Gregorian
m2_grammar.time_delta: on an armed Time lane of matching shape: TIME_HIT bit; if hit, signed delta = (scaled - previous) / shape_granularity charged in granularity units (granularity = 10^(9 - fraction_width) ns)

signed_delta_grammar.class_symbol: class tree symbol = magnitude_class - 1; magnitude_class = 128-bit-width of unsigned magnitude
signed_delta_grammar.mantissa: class-1 bits from a triangular-offset mantissa block (positions class-2 .. 0)
signed_delta_grammar.id_max_events_example: 72 (1 hit + 1 zero + 1 sign + 6 class + 63 mantissa) for the full i64 range
signed_delta_grammar.time_max_events_example: 78 (1 hit + 1 zero + 1 sign + 7 class + 68 mantissa) for the full 0000..9999 range

m2_grammar.escape: on any classification mismatch (or empty lane), one hit=false bit then the inner coder codes the exact bytes; the lane re-arms from the coded value
m2_grammar.seeding: after_miss_insert seeds each of the 64 lanes from the taught record's parsed values (uncharged); on_slots_cleared resets evicted slots' lanes to Empty

m3_grammar.visibility: sees every value that M2 escaped or found ineligible, before the inner coder; values consumed by an M2 hit never touch M3
m3_grammar.hit: M3_HIT bit = true; then a REFERENCE_TREE symbol (alphabet 65536) selecting the cached slot; reproduces the cached bytes exactly
m3_grammar.miss: M3_HIT bit = false; inner coder codes the value; then teach the decoded value (uncharged)
m3_grammar.cache_eligibility: values of 1..=128 bytes; seeding teaches every top-level value regardless of lane index

m4_grammar.visibility: terminates the chain; values consumed by an M2 or M3 hit never reach M4
m4_grammar.segment_loop: repeat: TOKEN_HIT bit; hit => longest dictionary token that is an exact prefix (8..32 bytes) coded as TOKEN_HIGH_TREE(slot/512) + TOKEN_LOW_TREE(slot%512), both alphabet 512; miss => one literal() run of the unmatched byte prefix up to the next matchable position; then a CONTINUE bit (more segments?)
m4_grammar.teach_rule: split value bytes into maximal ASCII-alphanumeric runs and maximal non-alphanumeric runs, clip each run left-to-right into 32-byte chunks, and insert every chunk of at least 8 bytes (uncharged, both sides)
m4_grammar.value_ceiling: decoder fails closed if the reconstructed value exceeds MAX_VALUE_BYTES = 1048576

cache_state_and_eviction.clock_rule: Deterministic CLOCK: the hand advances only during insertion; the reference bit is set on a decoded hit (encoder lookup / decoder select); reference bits are cleared while scanning; the first zero-bit slot in hand-relative ascending scan order (wrapping) is claimed; ties are broken by ascending scan order from the hand.

template_store.insertion_reserves_target: insert always calls next_victim once for the target (empty slots are claimed silently and not reported in cleared); under arena pressure it evicts further victims (excluding the reserved target) until the skeleton fits the 4194304-byte arena
template_store.cleared_report: only previously-occupied evicted slots are reported, in exact eviction order; later mechanisms clear their per-slot state from this list
template_store.uncacheable: skeleton > 65536 bytes is not inserted, clears last_slot, and returns uncacheable=true

m3_session_store.arena: none; fixed 65536 slots, pure CLOCK by slot count
m3_session_store.scope: item-scoped, not template-slot-scoped; on_slots_cleared does not clear session state

m4_token_store.arena_pressure: CLOCK plus arena pressure: keep evicting further victims (excluding the reserved target) until resident token bytes fit the 25165824-byte arena
m4_token_store.scope: item-scoped; on_slots_cleared does not clear token state

cache_state_and_eviction.m2_lane_clear: on_slots_cleared resets every lane of each evicted template slot to Empty (M2 lane state is template-slot-scoped)
cache_state_and_eviction.item_boundary_reset: all model, cache, dictionary, probability, and segment state resets to the fixed empty initial state at every item boundary (fresh construction, no partial reset)

segment_semantics.snapshot_rule: close a diagnostic segment snapshot at the first record boundary at or after each 16 MiB interval of consumed source
segment_semantics.state_reset: no model, cache, dictionary, or probability state resets at a segment boundary
segment_semantics.decision_role: segment snapshots are diagnostic-only and never enter decision calculations

tape_format.body_layout: packed bit bytes (ceil(bit_count/8), MSB-first within each byte) + literal_count[8 LE] + literal bytes
tape_format.trailer: 32-byte SHA-256 digest over all preceding bytes
tape_format.padding_rule: unused low bits of the final bit byte must be zero (non-canonical padding rejected)

record_semantics.record_definition: exact byte sequence through and including LF; final nonempty unterminated suffix is one record; empty final suffix is not a record

declared_limits.code_enforcement: MAX_RECORD_BYTES=1048576, MAX_DEPTH=32, MAX_FIELDS=256 in native/src/s0/json.rs; all three enforced (a violation routes the record to direct-literal fallback). See notes for exact semantics (depth counts the root object; field count is a total across all nested objects; arrays do not count toward fields).

projection_formulas.rounding: all divisions are ceiling (div_ceil) on u128; gain basis points use floor via i128 div_euclid

event_limit.scope: full arm only; total_modeled_binary_events <= 96 * record_count separately for every item and the aggregate; raw literal bytes are not modeled events; exceeding kills S0

gates.per_item_rule: every full-arm per-item complete projection must not exceed that item's single-item Kanzi AXE1O reference (630525, 438522, 643208)

attribution.interaction_policy: ordered-chain interactions credited to the later mechanism; leave-one-out interactions not separately assigned

gates.code_scope_note: The committed engine (ledger.rs) implements the aggregate/per-item projection, the Advance/RefineOnce/Kill byte-threshold decision, gain basis points, and the 96-events-per-record check. The attribution formulas, per-item Kanzi ceiling, full-minus-m4 quarantine, and refinement-band arbitration are protocol-level and would be enforced by the runner/verifier (not present in this kernel).

refined_differences.note: The refined constants manifest file is byte-identical to the base file except at exactly the two predeclared table maxima below (each stored once, in declared_ceilings). All mechanisms, context keys, hashes, update rules, item order, projection charges, event limit, thresholds, and derivation rules are byte-for-byte identical; the SSE bucket-bit growth is derived from the SSE maximum via mixer_and_sse.sse_bucket_bits_rule, not stored as a separate differing field.

engine_effect.sse: the SSE table grows from SSE_BASE_BUCKET_BITS=17 to SSE_REFINED_BUCKET_BITS=18 (M5Mixer::with_sse_bucket_bits), i.e. 17301504 bytes, above the base 16 MiB ceiling and within the refined 24 MiB ceiling
engine_effect.context_table: no engine table grows with the context_table ceiling increase in the current engine; all context tables are fixed compile-time sizes well under even the base ceiling (see notes: refined context ceiling is a declared-ceiling-only change here)

capacity_profile_rule: This manifest file is the base profile iff declared_ceilings.sse_table_bytes_maximum == 16777216 and the refined profile iff it == 25165824. The refined file is byte-identical to the base file except at exactly declared_ceilings.context_table_bytes_maximum and declared_ceilings.sse_table_bytes_maximum.

source_toolchain_build_identity.build_profile: cargo release profile: lto=fat, codegen-units=1, panic=abort, strip=true, opt-level default
source_toolchain_build_identity.binding_rule: The engine commit, per-file SHA-256 of every engine_source_files entry, the SHA-256 of both constants manifest files, and the runner/verifier SHA-256 values are recorded in the S0 freeze record committed before the first corpus measurement, per the protocol's freeze_requirements_before_measurement. A manifest cannot contain its own hash; the freeze record is the binding document.
